name: Loss of the eu-west-1 primary region
scope: Customer-facing order and payment path (orders-db, payments-api, public DNS). Out of scope: data warehouse, internal back-office, third-party PSP connectivity (simulated).
objectives: Prove that the eu-central-1 standby takes production traffic within the tier 1 RTO of 60 minutes
Measure the data loss on orders-db against the 5 minute RPO using Aurora global database replica lag
Exercise the decision chain from incident declaration to the regional failover decision
Produce evidence for DORA article 25 and the annual ISO 22301 exercise programme
scenario: At 09:00 UTC, monitoring reports a complete loss of connectivity to eu-west-1: EKS control plane unreachable, Aurora writer endpoint timing out, Route 53 health checks failing. The cloud provider status page confirms a regional event with no ETA. The incident commander must decide whether to fail over to eu-central-1.

systems.name: public DNS and edge
systems.strategy: Route 53 failover records + ARC routing control

injects.title: Regional outage alert
injects.description: PagerDuty alert: Route 53 health checks failing for eu-west-1 endpoints; synthetic checkout failing
injects.expected_response: On-call acknowledges, opens incident channel, declares SEV1 within 10 min

injects.title: Provider status page
injects.description: Simulated AWS Health event: eu-west-1 multi-AZ power event, no ETA
injects.expected_response: Incident commander convenes the failover decision call

injects.title: Failover decision
injects.description: Decision point: fail over or wait
injects.expected_response: Decision recorded with time, rationale and approver; replica lag read and logged before the switch

injects.title: Database promotion
injects.description: Promote eu-central-1 Aurora cluster (managed failover unavailable, use detach and promote)
injects.expected_response: Writer endpoint available in eu-central-1; application secrets updated

injects.title: Compute scale-up
injects.expected_response: Pods ready, readiness probes green, dependency checks pass

injects.title: Traffic switch
injects.description: Rotate ARC routing control to eu-central-1
injects.expected_response: Synthetic checkout succeeds from three regions; error rate under 1 %

injects.title: Stakeholder update
injects.description: Communications lead drafts customer status page update and regulator notification
injects.expected_response: Drafts ready and reviewed; not published (exercise)

injects.title: Business validation
injects.description: Business validator runs the checkout and refund checklist

injects.title: Rollback
injects.description: Primary region restored: re-establish replication, fail back during low traffic
injects.expected_response: Replication lag zero, data reconciled, traffic back on eu-west-1

success_criteria: Failover decision taken within 20 minutes of the SEV1 declaration
No manual edit of application configuration outside the documented runbook
communication: Service desk and on-call teams notified 48 h before; exercise channel #inc-exercise; all messages prefixed EXERCISE.
Customer status page: draft only, publication requires CTO approval during the exercise.
DORA major incident notification template completed as a drill and archived as evidence.
